speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a pediatric patient with a limp and localized pain, have you noticed any swelling, redness, or warmth in the affected area? Please also tell me exactly which bone or joint hurts when you press on it.

speaker: Patient
text: 7-year-old male. Mother has noticed a change in the child’s play patterns, specifically favoring his left leg while walking or running. The child complains of pain in his left knee, but denies any recent trauma or injury. He has no fever or other systemic symptoms. Nutrition and developmental milestones are appropriate for age.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease. The age (7 years), pain localized to the left knee (referred from the hip), limp, and absence of trauma or fever are classic presentations for this condition.
